estimates.conventions: letters, calls, 3Q26 10-Q, FY26 10-K if filed by the print date (two of the last three were same-day); share must be of total Nights and Seats Booked or total GBV (city-level excluded); the resolver may add separately disclosed shares of the same denominator; 'single-digit'/'low-single-digit' = No, 'mid-single-digit'/'high-single-digit'/'approximately 3%'/'over 3%' = Yes; a share 'of nights booked' is accepted as a share of the reported KPI; FY27 revenue figure must be a company statement >= $500M for 2027

model.structure: hotel-descriptor upgrade hazards 0.12 (5 Nov) and 0.20 (Feb letter/call plus the same-day 10-K venue) -> P(upgraded) 0.296 x P(figure or bucket >= 3) 0.55 = 0.163; other routes (seats 0.02, GBV 0.02, FY27 revenue 0.03, combined sentence 0.03, aggregation of two sub-3 figures 0.02) 0.114; union 0.259; final 0.25

impact.note: Immaterial. A disclosure does not change the business: hotel and seats volumes are already inside reported nights, their ADR dilution (-0.5pp) and take-rate incentives are in the team path, and Experiences/Services cost sits in field ops. Stock +$2 as a narrative re-rating (a 3-5% share growing ~30% reads as ~1pt of structural growth), haircut because the same disclosure shows homes growing ~1pt slower than reported nights and makes the mix drag explicit. The memo can drop it or fold it into the ADR paragraph.
